cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — standing; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing with one foot up on a step; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — perched on a ledge or edge; A century-old lakeside bathhouse with a dry pebble path cut between two shallow pools — She tests the rhythm of seven skipping stones by laying them out from smallest to largest along the warm coping; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — holds her keepsake up beside her face; A disused stained-glass workshop with a broad bay window and bins of coloured glass offcuts — She holds two glass offcuts together and projects the colours onto a blank page to choose a visual rhythm for her next verse; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a riverside seating area waiting for festival fireworks — fans a folding fan open between her hands; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — chest-deep in the water; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — sitting on the ground; the top of a restored ancient city wall — lifts a paper kite on a string overhead into the wind to launch it; a desert oasis at golden hour — holds her keepsake at chest height
